signal_summary: Choose the dominant, center-biased green component as the likely target plant anchor.
why_helpful: Provides a stable starting point for indoor pot localization when multiple neighboring pots are visible.

signal_summary: Detect bright vertical label rectangles near the main canopy to support pot alignment.
why_helpful: Adds a second cue for indoor pot identity and helps diagnose cases where plant-only anchoring is ambiguous.

signal_summary: Infer a pot-shaped trapezoid and score how isolated the target canopy is from neighboring spillover.
why_helpful: Turns multi-pot frames into a reproducible per-pot region so growth metrics are less contaminated by adjacent seedlings.

signal_summary: Measure canopy coverage only inside the inferred pot footprint.
why_helpful: Closer to the real indoor use case than whole-image vegetation coverage because it suppresses nearby-pot noise.

signal_summary: Estimate how much green signal appears immediately outside the target pot region.
why_helpful: Flags frames that still need custom masking or tighter capture before they are trustworthy for longitudinal tracking.

signal_summary: Change in in-pot canopy coverage versus the earliest baseline image for the same pot.
why_helpful: Gives a directional growth signal for pots that already have a baseline capture, even before a learned detector exists.
